description: Make TampinesSteamArray an all-Mach hybrid: keep the pressure-based PIMPLE skeleton, inject KNP central-upwind (rhoCentralFoam) dissipation as a Mach-weighted beta(Ma) deferred-correction flux. Copy the KNP flux MATH into tampines (NO outram-foam dependency; tampines already has all types + speed of sound w_ph_wood_wallis; preserve GPLv3/OpenFOAM provenance header). Opt-in SolverMode{Pimple,HybridAllMach}, default Pimple => beta=0 => bit-identical to current => plateau fix + 915 tests preserved by construction. Goal: damp the near-sonic ringing at the Edwards flashing front while retaining the plateau/no-subcooling.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsiDesktop
notes.content: MAINTAINER DIRECTIVE (2026-07-16): TampinesSteamArray must be HEM through-and-through — the equilibrium sound speed (Kieffer, above), the KNP wave speeds (u +/- a_HEM), and critical/choked flow all use the HEM equilibrium closure. Critical flow is already HEM (the break BC uses get_critical_pressure_and_mass_flux_multiphase_ph, the validated HEM choked-flow dispatcher). No Wood-Wallis, no frozen, no perfect-gas anywhere.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsiDesktop
notes.content: Core deliverable DONE (B1-B6 closed). SolverMode{Pimple(default),HybridAllMach} opt-in; default Pimple bit-identical (915 baseline + 5 new central_upwind tests = 920 lib pass, 0 fail). HEM equilibrium sound speed throughout (Kieffer eq.28 in dome via s from (p,h) flash; w_tp_1/2/3/5 single-phase; NOT Wood-Wallis). KNP dissipation on continuity+momentum (energy carried implicitly by continuity-into-phi to preserve plateau cancellation); min(Ma) gating (low-Mach scaling avoids liquid-interface blowup); validity-edge guard. Edwards: ringing -55.5% (excess-TV 4670->2079), plateau retained 392.7->387.7 psia. Remaining: op-21g.15.7 (late-time >0.18s hardening). NOTE incident op-6zi (accidental revert destroyed uncommitted op-21g.14 ddt_coeff_old + set_outlet_velocity; reconstructed & verified via exact Pimple-full reproduction).

notes.author: teddy0@snrsiDesktop
notes.content: MAINTAINER DECISION (2026-07-16): default SolverMode::Pimple (HEM-closed PIMPLE) is the VALIDATED, kept path — recovers the Edwards plateau (392.7 psia) and is stable over the full 600 ms. SolverMode::HybridAllMach is EXPERIMENTAL / future work: it damps the near-sonic ringing (~55%) over 0-0.15s but CRASHES past t~0.18s. Marked experimental in the SolverMode doc. The late-time instability (op-21g.15.7) is a substantial standalone work item, not a quick harden.

title: Hybrid all-Mach (rhoCentralFoam + rhoPimpleFoam) TampinesSteamArray

description: Per workspace rule + user requirement: model CoolProp's AbstractState/backend polymorphism (HelmholtzEOSMixtureBackend, IncompressibleBackend, HumidAir, ...) and the fluid set as Rust ENUMS with match-based dispatch -- no Box<dyn Trait>/&dyn.
